svg.aria-label: The AI model stack on one machine: Qwen 3.8 27B kept loaded on a 24 GB graphics card; specialist models loaded on demand (Nemotron review, Ornith prototypes, MOSS-Image illustrations, Kandinsky video, Whisper transcription, Kokoro voices, Qwen3 Embedding relevance ranking); the IA Next Local app; self-hosted web search through SearXNG; HiC as an optional link; and paid model APIs, which are blocked.
